name: Himeno Kyouko
source:
3rd year high school student.
She's an attractive, athletic, and smart superwoman. However she isn't prideful about it and treats everybody around her as an equal.
She is suddenly struck by the mysterious disease "Glass Heart Syndrome" where any sudden excitement could cause her to go into cardiac arrest.
